classification.basis: OS model and normal-seek response plus manufacturer WD10EALX specification (7200 RPM); GetPhysicalDisk itself reports Unspecified

provenance.build_profile: Cargo test dev profile; all features; explicit x86_64-pc-windows-msvc target

fixture.cache_note: Files were just created or reused; OS cache was neither flushed nor evicted. First means first observed scan in this session, not cold cache.
fixture.index_placement: Separate per-run index directory on the same physical volume as the fixture.

method.timer_scope: immediately before begin JSON through adapter.scan return, including progress JSON instrumentation; excludes process startup, fixture creation and completed-result queries
method.first_state_scope: native progress callback; renderer state is measured by the separate Desktop probe
method.memory_scope: fresh native process peak working set including libtest/runtime/SQLite; excludes Node, Gateway and Electron
method.cancellation_scope: cancel at first file progress; actual dispatch callbacks and cancellation checks instrumented under cfg(test)

events.preparation: ordinary create/write/close; no cache flush or cache eviction
